Canadian annual average and median retirement ages among all retirees, 2015–2025. Total gender and total class of worker are selected explicitly.

BC annual interprovincial migration from 2015/2016 onward. Arrivals and departures each sum the 12 other provinces and territories; net is calculated only when every flow is reported.

Top 10 destination countries for BC-origin goods exports in 2025. Values are nominal Canadian dollars from the original Value ($Cdn) column.

CMHC BC housing starts for March and January–March 2025 and 2026. Monthly and cumulative intervals overlap and remain separate.

Interior BC and provincial CREA markets do not correspond to Northern Health or municipal Census polygons. No Northern or Prince George prices are inferred.
